items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-01-16
items.q: This fellow was around here, I think. He's young. McNeil, bro.

ctx.x: You don't know which bro? There was two bros, huh? I think so.
This fellow was around here, I think. He's young. McNeil, bro. Huh?
McNeil, bro. He's here and Wellman, bro, is the old one. That's the one.
